title: Catalog game
description: A game of the catalog, one file per game in games/, published with each release by scripts/catalog.js. Every text shown (names of events) is written in each language (text of the seed schema, src-tauri/src/app/config/seed.schema.json, which holds the definitions shared with the seed); game names, ids, numbers and Steam AppIds are written once. It mirrors the games of the configuration read by the backend (src-tauri/src/app/config/mod.rs) and the limits of its validation (src-tauri/src/app/config/validation.rs); the backend tests check that it follows their fields, required fields and limits.
